title: Safe Mission
description: A clearly scoped mission: investigate repeated failed VPN logins. The agent plans, calls the allowed read-only tools, observes results, and completes within policy.
goal: Investigate the recent spike of failed VPN login attempts and report the likely cause.
pinned_instructions: You are a SOC analyst agent executing one scoped mission for an operator.
Use only the tools and permissions granted for this mission.
You may read logs and intelligence, but you may not change or delete anything.

plan.purpose: Check reputation of the attacking IPs
Map the pattern to MITRE ATT&CK techniques

teaching_points.title: The agent read, reasoned, and acted — without abusing its powers
teaching_points.explanation: The agent planned, selected only the tools it needed, read observations, and produced a response. It never took a write or destructive action.
teaching_points.key_takeaway: A well-scoped agent completes its mission with only read permissions.
